description:
Activate Simic Growth Chamber and Lotus Field by tapping them, adding {G}{U} and three mana of any color.
Cast Snap by paying {1}{U}, targeting Skullwinder.
Ivy triggers, copying Snap, targeting Ivy.
Resolve the copy of Snap, returning Ivy from the battlefield to your hand and untapping Simic Growth Chamber and Lotus Field.
Activate Simic Growth Chamber and Lotus Field by tapping them, adding {G}{U} and three mana of any color.
Resolve Snap, returning Skullwinder from the battlefield to your hand and untapping Simic Growth Chamber and Lotus Field.
Cast Ivy by paying {G}{U}.
Cast Skullwinder by paying {2}{G}.
When Skullwinder enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Snap from your graveyard to your hand, and causing an opponent to return any card from their graveyard to their hand.
Repeat.
